dissent: The retained-request bypass makes the boundary guard per-request idempotent, not a global freshness gate: a duplicate pub-retry after source-restart/publisher-revoke returns the durable receipt with no freshness check (s_domain.py:113 exercises this shape). If the intent was freshness at every pub-* call, the code does not provide it.

Attestation equality is strictly conditional: the adapter rollback on Q refusal (a_inclusive.py:15) has no S-side counterpart, so any reachable guard-pass/Q-refuse attestation breaks journal equality; supplied sources do not exclude such fixtures.
a_split.py:17 '!=' versus '>' elsewhere is a genuine textual asymmetry; the invariant should record it rather than assume equivalence.
findings: [source-inference] Capture clause: on every enabled stage/stage-* action (always delegated: s_inclusive.py:73-74, guard_a.py:75, guard_b.py:88), post.staged_source == pre.attestation on both sides, independent of Q's stage decision (s_inclusive.py:75, s_split.py:94, s_audit.py:107, a_inclusive.py:17, a_split.py:16, a_audit.py:27). Falsifier: any compared prefix where post-stage staged_source differs from pre attestation, or sides differ. staged_source==() after a stage is reachable (empty attestation captured).

[source-inference] Persistence clause: only stage writes staged_source; only a publication_revision increase writes selected_source := pre.staged_source (s_inclusive.py:76, s_split.py:95, a_inclusive.py:18, a_audit.py:28). Compared journal key set is (*s.EXTRA,'source_generation') (s_domain.py:12-13, adapter_traces.py:20).

[source-inference] Restart clause: source-restart always invokes Q (not source_only, a_domain.py:11-13; q_inclusive.py:13 unconditional +1) and the adapter bumps journal generation identically (a_inclusive.py:16, a_split.py:15, a_audit.py:26). No journal field is cleared; stale attestation/staged_source/selected_source persist and are detected lazily by [:2]==(source_generation,source_revision) tests.

[source-inference] Current-source publication guard (exact): a pub-* call whose incoming request id is absent from publication_receipts delegates iff attestation!=() AND attestation[:2]==(source_generation,source_revision) AND staged_source==attestation; else decision k:source-boundary-stale, journal unchanged (s_inclusive.py:71, s_audit.py:102, guard_a.py:73, guard_b.py:80-83, guard_audit.py:84). Retained request ids bypass the guard entirely (s_inclusive.py:12, s_audit.py:33-34, q_domain.py incoming). Reconcile guard: selected_source!=() AND [:2]==(gen,rev) (s_inclusive.py:72, s_audit.py:103, guard_a.py:74, guard_b.py:85-87, guard_audit.py:85).

[malformed-hypothetical] a_split.py:17 tests publication_revision with '!=' where s_inclusive.py:76, s_split.py:95, a_inclusive.py:18, a_audit.py:28 use '>': equivalent only while revision is monotone (reachable); divergent on hypothetical revision-decreasing states. First-match (guard_a.py:38) vs dict-lookup (guard_b.py:39) append receipts agree only under the unique-request-id invariant (s_audit.py:17-24).

[source-inference] Non-narrowing holds: journal correspondence is exact typed equality (adapter_traces.py:20) with no freshness premise; stale-but-equal states remain related; 'staged' gaps use 'original-object-identity' (identity.py:62) which establishes no incarnation pair (identity.py:65); contract forbids current-stage-freshness premises (validation-contract.json:8).

Missing premises: (M1) delegated-Q coupling: adapter commits journal attestation iff Q returns source-attest:ok, else rolls back (a_inclusive.py:15, a_split.py:14, a_audit.py:25), while S commits locally (s_inclusive.py:69, s_audit.py:100) — any reachable guard-pass/Q-refuse attestation breaks equality (prestage obligation 1). (M2) three-way generation consistency: S-gen==journal-gen exactly, S-gen~core-gen via pairs (semantic.py:51-53 paired-restart needs a prior pair; semantic.py:104-105 pre-attestation fallback needs empty source_name). (M3) retained-request agreement needs related core staged/receipts. (M4) mutant=None only (guard_a.py:8; S mutants bypass guards at s_inclusive.py:65,71,72). (M5) identical enabledness over identical typed histories.

summary: Derived an exact conditional invariant for the staged_source journal lifecycle across S and both adapters: unconditional capture at stage, persistence elsewhere, restart lazily invalidating via generation, per-request current-source publication guard, and reconcile guard. Clauses are falsifiable with path:line anchors; five missing premises enumerated; smallest decisive check proposed. This is a conditional lemma over reachable typed histories, not an all-orders theorem.
